anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, opportunities generated, or adjustments made, indicating it may not be functioning or is idle.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss, suggesting inactivity or potential issues with trading strategies.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage by analyzing running processes and load distribution.
Review and potentially restart AI systems to ensure they are actively learning and generating opportunities.
Evaluate current trading strategies for effectiveness and consider adjustments or alternative strategies.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the cause of high CPU load to prevent potential system instability or downtime.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system performance degradation, affecting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Restart or troubleshoot the AI system to ensure it is operational and contributing to trading decisions.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity may lead to missed trading opportunities and reduced platform effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Conduct a review of trading strategies and performance metrics to identify any issues or areas for improvement.
recommendations.rationale: Optimizing trading strategies can enhance profitability and platform competitiveness.
